pages: Noeline Farrant, a woman of fifty-six, grey hair cropped short, a white lab coat open over a navy top, leans over an open ledger with a red cloth spine on its side, her pen on the last line. Middle distance: the bench, a printer, a capped blood tube. Background: shelves of grey boxes, a torn window screen. Morning light.

Noeline Farrant, a woman of fifty-six, grey hair cropped short, a white lab coat open over a navy top, sits at the bench with one hand flat on a desktop screen showing columns of figures. Middle distance: the printer, a keyboard, a capped blood tube. Background: shelving, a hatch in the wall. Fluorescent light, colourless.

Gwen Iverson, a woman of her sixties in retirement, grey hair under a cotton headscarf and a cardigan over a floral blouse, stands at the lab bench holding an unlit cigarette behind her back and a pen in front of her. Middle distance: a request form, a rack of tubes. Background: the hatch, a window. Morning light.

Aroha Bell, a woman of fifty-eight in a woolly hat and a green quilted jacket, sits on a chair in a practice room and turns one paper request form over in her hands. Middle distance: a strip curtain, a blood-taking tray, a second chair. Background: a window onto a car park. Flat daylight.

One capped blood tube stands in an open cardboard box on a bench in a small practice room. Middle distance: a wall clock, a paper request form beside the box, a stack of forms. Background: a strip curtain, a window onto a car park. Cold morning light through the glass.

One capped blood tube with a printed barcode label on its end sits in a rack under a scanner's red beam. Middle distance: the scanner, an open ledger with a red cloth spine, a capped second tube. Background: the bench, a printer, shelves. Fluorescent light, and the beam on the cap.

Aroha Bell, a woman of fifty-eight in the green quilted jacket and woolly hat, sits on a trolley with one hand turned palm up and a cannula taped to it, looking up at a wall screen. Middle distance: a drip stand, a trolley rail, a folded blanket. Background: an emergency department bay, a doorway. Bright clinical light.

A bag of clear fluid hangs from a drip stand above a forearm on a bed, the drip falling slowly into a taped cannula. Middle distance: a monitor, a clipboard, a chair. Background: an emergency department bay, a curtain drawn round the bed. A bright overhead clinical light falls across the bag.

A forearm on a chair armrest with a strap round the upper arm and one capped tube going into the crook. Middle distance: a stainless tray, a strip of print curling from a machine, a sharps bin. Background: an emergency department bay, a window black outside. Night light over the bed.

Noeline Farrant, a woman of fifty-six, grey hair cropped short, a white lab coat open over a navy top, works a calculator on the bench beside the open red ledger. Middle distance: a wall clock, a pen, a tray of capped tubes. Background: shelving of grey boxes, a hatch. Fluorescent light, and daylight low at the window.

One capped blood tube stands in a metal rack in front of a bright lamp, red plasma above a red layer at the bottom. Middle distance: the bench, a pair of gloves, a rack of further tubes. Background: an analyser housing, a printer. Fluorescent light, and the lamp shining through the tube.

R. Fenwick, a man of twenty-six in a white coat open over a hoodie, holds a telephone handset to his ear and writes on one paper form held flat on the bench. Middle distance: the bench, a keyboard, a monitor. Background: an office wall, a window with daylight. Overhead light, and the handset cord.

R. Fenwick, a man of twenty-six in a white coat open over a hoodie, sits at the desk with the handset in one hand and one paper form in front of him, two small boxes ruled on it and the second left blank. Middle distance: the monitor, a keyboard, a mug. Background: an office window, daylight.

Aroha Bell, a woman of fifty-eight in the green quilted jacket, holds one paper referral by its corner at a desk, a date written in the corner at the top of it. Middle distance: a pen, a file tray, a chair. Background: an office window with the blind half down. Flat daylight.

Aroha Bell, a woman of fifty-eight in a green quilted jacket, reads three hospital letters held together in both hands at a desk. Middle distance: an open ring binder, a pen, an in-tray, a chair. Background: a clinic room window, a radiator. Flat daylight falls across all three printed sheets.

Aroha Bell, a woman of fifty-eight in the green quilted jacket, holds one paper referral by its corner at a desk, a date written in the top corner of it. Middle distance: a pen, a file tray, a chair. Background: an office window with the blind half down. Flat daylight.

Noeline Farrant, a woman of fifty-six, grey hair cropped short, a white lab coat open over a navy top, stands at a bench with a ledger open beside a column of figures ruled down its sheet. Middle distance: a calculator, a stack of request forms, a pen. Background: an office door. Fluorescent light, and her finger on the last row.

Noeline Farrant, a woman of fifty-six, grey hair cropped short, a white lab coat open over a navy top, sits at the bench with capped tubes laid out in two rows on a sheet of paper. Middle distance: an open ledger, a pen, a calculator. Background: the analyser, a printer, a window. Bright fluorescent light over the two rows.

Noeline Farrant, a woman of fifty-six, grey hair cropped short, a white lab coat open over a navy top, sits in the driver's seat of a car in a still staff car park, both hands on the wheel. Middle distance: the open red ledger on the passenger seat, a paper cup. Background: a hospital wall. Afternoon light through the windscreen.

Noeline Farrant, a woman of fifty-six, grey hair cropped short, a white lab coat open over a navy top, holds a telephone handset to her ear at her bench. Middle distance: the printer, a monitor, a stack of printed reports. Background: shelving, a hatch. Fluorescent light, and daylight low at the window behind her.

Noeline Farrant, a woman of fifty-six, grey hair cropped short, a white lab coat open over a navy top, slides an open ledger with a red cloth spine onto a shelf among identical red volumes. Middle distance: a grey archive box, a shelf label, a printer. Background: a long wall of shelving, a window. Morning light down the aisle.
